intro.text: At PARRI GROUP MANEGEMENT S.L we are specialists in the strategic management and trading of hydrocarbons and energy products at an international level. With a solid operational base in Spain and a network of connections spanning the main global supply hubs, we act as the vital link between energy production and demand.
intro.text2: Our expertise focuses on high-level intermediation and the wholesale trading of fuels, where agility and market analysis are our main tools. We don't just move resources; we bring commercial intelligence to mitigate risks in volatile environments, ensuring our partners always obtain the best supply conditions.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To provide high-efficiency trading and exchange solutions, connecting global markets through the use of advanced technology and in-depth analysis. We are committed to maximizing value for our clients and partners through precise execution and responsible risk management, optimizing the global energy supply chain and ensuring an uninterrupted flow of energy to key sectors.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To become the global benchmark in the trading sector, recognized for our operational integrity, our capacity for technological innovation and our positive impact on the liquidity and stability of the markets in which we operate, delivering innovative logistics solutions that generate profitability for our partners and energy security for end markets.

growth.title: A resilient and scalable business model
growth.text: Between 2022 and 2025 the company experienced an upward trajectory, growing revenue from €18M to €29M. This increase is no coincidence, but the result of disciplined execution: consolidation as a link between international refineries and end distributors, alliances in high-value products (Repsol and Castrol), optimization of the integrated logistics chain and advanced risk management through hedging.
